data.text: Manage high-volume premium collections across diverse product lines and geographies with robust, scalable virtual account solutions for complex treasury needs.
Embed real-time payment and account services directly into your platform, offering a seamless, branded experience for policyholders and instant policy activation.
Streamline premium collection and reconciliation for multiple insurers or agents, ensuring accurate fund routing and transparent commission management.
Automate recurring premium collections through direct debit capabilities linked to virtual accounts, reducing delinquencies and administrative overhead.
Facilitate efficient and traceable payouts for claims, agent commissions, or refunds directly from your virtual account structure, enhancing financial control.
Support premium collection in multiple currencies across various jurisdictions, simplifying international operations and global policyholder payments.
